_comment: Example Viam component config for the viam:ethercat:a6-servo motor model.
Set "simulate": true (or interface "sim") to run against the in-memory
#18: there is NO control_mode and NO rxpdo/txpdo -- the driver is ALWAYS
switch-capable (each motor API call ensures its own mode at runtime) and
defines ONE fixed CiA402 superset PDO map itself. Only identity + motor facts
+ the A6 hardware bits are config. #59: reached/is_moving is position-stability
0.5deg) and velocity_threshold is an optional override.
